description: This Java source file defines the SparkGenericUDAFBridge class, which extends GenericUDAFBridge to provide a Spark-specific implementation for evaluating user-defined aggregate functions (UDAFs) in Hive. It includes methods for obtaining evaluators and an inner class for evaluator logic, utilizing Hive's function registry utilities.
